findings.headline: Drop this useContext undefined fallback: rc.21 throws instead of returning undefined.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 types createContext() without a default as Context<T> and throws ContextNotFoundError when no Provider is mounted, so useContext(TodosContext) returns T and never undefined; the ctx falsiness/null check here reads as dead code to a TypeScript reader and hides the throw at runtime.
findings.guidance: Delete the ctx falsiness/null/undefined check: a wrapper that threw on undefined becomes a plain useContext call, and callers that relied on the undefined fallback should either pass an explicit default to createContext (use null for an optional context — rc.21 treats undefined as "not provided" and still throws) or wrap the useContext call in try/catch. Stop and ask when the branch does real recovery (not just a throw), when the context's declaration is unclear, or when ctx escapes this function so the test might run far from here.
